QuestInfo.name: Looking for a Call to Answer
QuestInfo.0: Being Kaiser is a big responsibility. You should use this power to help the people of Nova...but how? #p3000003# in Pantheon is pretty busy. Maybe you can help?
QuestInfo.1: Go visit #b#p3000003##k at #b#m400000001##k and ask if he needs any help.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000003# seems pretty busy. What can you do to help?

0.0: Someone great once said that with great power, comes great responsibility. I've got great power coming out of my ears, so I guess I should do something to help Nova with it. Maybe some people in town could use my immense help?

yes.0: #p3000003#'s always busy with his science...stuff. I bet he needs burly help. Okay self, get to #b#m400000001##k and look for #b#p3000003##k! Let's do this!

no.0: ...Or maybe I could beat up some more monsters first, and then be helpful.

1.0: Hm? Oh hey, Kaiser! You're just in time...I need some burly help with something. You up for it?

yes.0: Hey Kaiser. I don't need any heavy lifting or monster beating right now, but come back in a bit and I might have something for you to do.

npc.0: #b#p3000003##k is at #b#m400000001##k. Why is this so hard to remember?
